Data Handling Policy

The controller may process personal data for billing purposes.
The processor shall notify the controller within 72 hours, in accordance with Article 33.
Staff are prohibited from sharing account credentials with third parties.
The processor must delete personal data when a contract terminates.
The processor must not delete personal data if litigation is pending.
Must retain audit logs for one year.
Compliance with this policy is mandatory for all personnel.
Each business unit is responsible for its own risk register.
